maxVersionNote: 0.5.5 (feat/ds-role-variables, 16/10/2026) is the first release whose stylesheets read every standard role variable themselves (var(--ds-*, <its own value>), design-system-roles.json: 0 unresolved), re-measured on the release build (contracts/0.5.5); 0.5.6 (16/10/2026) fits the Add site preview under Moxie and Figma, both modes: the call band's button is drawn in the band's words on the dark side, the dark scene band takes the quiet raised ground, the call capsule leaves room for a wider face, the swatch rule sits on its label and the worn-only shades are defined only while a system is worn; re-measured on the release build (contracts/0.5.6)
splitNote: the role-reading line of emdash/tracy-base: releases from 0.5.5 on wear a system through the role variables alone (readsRoles). Releases 0.5.0 to 0.5.4 read the template patches of emdash-base.json, which stays as it was for every site still built from them

discoveredNote: read 14/10/2026 off the published release with no system worn (the v6 measure's baseline/default.json): the hero line's size on a desktop and a phone, its first family (an Astro font family name without its hash suffix), weight and letter spacing, and the first section heading. tracy-base's stack opens on -apple-system and system-ui, the reader's own system face, which the width table (src/font-widths.json) cannot name: the first family of the stack it knows, Helvetica Neue, stands in (SF Pro on the Mac that measured it sets a line about as wide). Until then emdashCss gave the slot no template sizes, so Eddie's 80px Inter 600 stood a five-line tower in tracy-base's centred hero column and six lines in Tracy Business's half-width one (look review v6)
readsRolesNote: the theme reads every standard role variable itself (var(--ds-*, <its own value>) on every colour, corner and face, role-variables.mjs; feat/ds-role-variables, 15/10/2026): the slot writes the role values only, for both sides (role-values.mjs), and none of the per-template patches it carried before (templateVars, followRules, bandButtons, bandText, shapeRules, status, omit, fontVars). A release of the theme that does not read the roles yet still needs them: they stay in emdash-base.json, the contract of those releases
readsComponentsNote: the theme reads the slot's type and shape tokens (global.css: --ds-weight-*, --ds-size-*, --ds-tracking-display, --ds-leading-display, --ds-btn-radius, --ds-card-radius, --ds-input-radius), so the emitter reads them off an OpenDesign system's reference page (components.html) as for Tracy Business (#1309). Measured 14/10/2026 on the released 0.5.2 without it: ROLE-1 failed under BMW, Stripe and Spotify (the template's own weights, sizes and 980px button radius stayed)
modesNote: the theme has a light/dark switch ([data-tracy-theme-toggle] in Header.astro and OnepageHeader.astro, data-theme on html): the slot emits the system's own side under the side the system is and the other side derived from it (src/derive.mjs), and keeps the switch (Akemi 13/10/2026: hiding it is a bug; MODE-2). The theme opens on the system's side from 0.5.4 (lib/ds-slot.ts reads the sheet's mode line; a choice made under a system is stored under tracy-base-theme@<id>, UNDO-1); 0.5.0 to 0.5.3 hid the switch under a system and read the derived side only through the switch
